title: Orca's released policy, exported for agent_cubic and checked against Orca's own code
description: Orca (Abbasloo, Yen and Chao, SIGCOMM 2020; github.com/Soheil-ab/Orca at cafaf9a, MIT-licensed, its notice in orca/LICENSE-orca.txt) converted to run in palaestra: experiments/orca_weights.py runs Orca's own envwrapper.py state code, d5.py's 10-step history and agent.py's Actor (TensorFlow 2.4.1 in v1 mode, restoring models/model.ckpt-1283529) on a synthetic stream of 600 server messages (orca/raw.npy, experiments/orca_export.py stream), and experiments/orca_export.py rewrites the whole policy in torch: Orca's slow start (the window times 1.1 until ssthresh falls below cwnd), its 7 features from TCP_CC_INFO and TCP_INFO, the actor, and its window percent int(100 * 4^a). The export is checked step by step against Orca's code on that stream (orca/check.txt). orca/orca.onnx is the policy; run it as an agent_cubic agent with a 20 ms period (NAME=orca.onnx@cubic:20). Later experiments take this release as an input.
run: T=$(mktemp -d); git clone --quiet https://github.com/Soheil-ab/Orca.git "$T/orca"; git -C "$T/orca" checkout --quiet cafaf9a31cb63a5b8754e1f410776d35b8ce47d0; uv venv --quiet --python 3.8 "$T/tf"; uv pip install --quiet --python "$T/tf/bin/python" tensorflow-cpu==2.4.1 numpy==1.19.5 protobuf==3.20.3; mkdir -p "$OUT/orca"; uv run python experiments/orca_export.py stream "$OUT/orca/raw.npy"; "$T/tf/bin/python" -I experiments/orca_weights.py "$T/orca" "$OUT/orca/raw.npy" "$OUT/orca/ref"; uv run python experiments/orca_export.py export "$OUT/orca/ref" "$OUT/orca/orca.onnx" | tee "$OUT/orca/check.txt"; cp "$T/orca/copyright" "$OUT/orca/LICENSE-orca.txt"; rm -rf "$OUT/orca/ref/rl_logging"; (cd "$OUT/orca" && sha256sum -- orca.onnx check.txt LICENSE-orca.txt raw.npy ref/* > SHA256SUMS)
